prompt: Read both open Zotero pages. I need to share 1 GB of PDFs with a research group. Compare Zotero Storage and WebDAV in a small table: group-file support, who supplies storage, and relevant costs. Recommend an option based only on these pages. Do not purchase anything. Answer in English, under 150 words.
answers:
I’ll read both open Zotero pages and compare their group-sharing support and costs.
Copy

Option
Group-file support
Who supplies storage
Relevant costs



Zotero Storage
Yes; files count against the group owner’s quota
Zotero
300 MB free; 2 GB costs US$20/year. No additional group charge.


WebDAV
No; personal libraries only
Your employer, research institution, or a third-party provider
Free and paid options exist; these pages give no specific prices.


Recommendation: Use Zotero Storage’s 2 GB plan for your 1 GB of group PDFs, provided the group owner’s other stored files fit within the remaining space. It supports group attachments; WebDAV does not.
No purchase was made.
